units.source_text: 与尚侍胧月夜的信，照例寄给中纳言君，装作给这侍女的私信。

en.t: The letter to Oborozukiyo, the Naishi no Kami, was sent as usual to Chūnagon no Kimi, disguised as a private note addressed to that attendant.

units.source_text: 其中有云：“寂寞无聊之时，惟有追思往事。

en.t: In it he wrote, "When I am lonely and weary, all I can do is look back on the past.
